name: PlenOctree
definition: An octree-based 3D representation (sparse voxel-based octree) that supports view-dependent effects by storing appearance and density values required to model radiance at a point in the volume. It is named after plenoptic functions.
summary: PlenOctree is an octree-based 3D representation that enables real-time NeRF rendering by pre-tabulating view-dependent radiance into a sparse voxel structure, replacing slow neural inference with direct lookups.
